description: Defines the IOBuffer class and its variants used for asynchronous IO operations in the net namespace, including reference counting, ownership semantics, and various buffer types.

classes.name: IOBuffer
classes.description: Reference counted data buffer for asynchronous IO, managing ownership and lifetime of the underlying char* buffer.

classes.name: IOBufferWithSize
classes.description: Extends IOBuffer to include size information, used for buffers with known length.

classes.name: StringIOBuffer
classes.description: Immutable IOBuffer backed by a std::string, for read-only data.

classes.name: DrainableIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer that can be consumed progressively, allowing partial writes and seeking.

classes.name: GrowableIOBuffer
classes.description: Resizable buffer with adjustable capacity and offset, suitable for reading data of unknown size.

classes.name: PickledIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer that uses a base::Pickle for storage, avoiding data copies during write operations.

classes.name: WrappedIOBuffer
classes.description: Temporary IOBuffer that does not own the underlying data, used for synchronous operations.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the underlying buffer data.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: DidConsume
methods.description: Marks bytes as consumed in the buffer.

methods.name: BytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns the number of unconsumed bytes.

methods.name: BytesConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes already consumed.

methods.name: SetOffset
methods.description: Sets the current offset within the buffer.

methods.name: SetCapacity
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to the specified capacity.

methods.name: StartOfBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to the start of the buffer in GrowableIOBuffer.

methods.name: pickle
methods.description: Returns pointer to the internal base::Pickle object.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Marks the pickle as ready for IO operation.
